phosphor-robot-a#0.notes: Concept A representative: glowing green line-art box robot, eye on the east side, reads at 48 on light and dark; came out isometric, not top-down

phosphor-step-a#0.notes: Arrow centre is on-concept and reads in all 4 rotations, but the surround is rainbow circuit noise (blue/purple), off the monochrome phosphor concept

phosphor-lava-a#0.notes: Amber contour lines are on-concept but a green rim and grey bevel frame the tile; 3x3 repeat shows seams

phosphor-lava-b#0.notes: Pixflux reseed tiles seamlessly but is almost entirely black with dim speckle; no readable lava

circuit-robot-a#0.notes: Isometric navy cube with orange speckle noise and glyph-like marks; muddy at 48, not the crisp PCB icon look

circuit-step-a#0.notes: Gold arrow is crisp and reads in all rotations, but the board sits on a grey margin (not edge to edge) and is covered in speckle noise

circuit-lava-a#0.notes: Draws a circuit chip framed by lava, not a lava floor; framed and not seamless

circuit-lava-b#0.notes: Pixflux reseed tiles seamlessly but is a teal PCB pattern with no lava (off-subject); possible circuit-floor reference

toybox-robot-a#0.notes: Concept C representative: cute cream/red toy robot, clear silhouette, antenna, blue visor on the east-facing side; three-quarter rather than top-down view

toybox-step-a#0.notes: Concept C representative: chunky red arrow on a blue panel, reads at native size in all 4 rotations; wood corners repeat cleanly; baked top-left highlight rotates with the tile

toybox-lava-a#0.notes: Dark brick frame around the edge and stray blue-grey blobs; not seamless

toybox-lava-b#0.notes: Best lava look of the set (chunky orange pool), but rock edges on two sides break the 3x3 repeat; not a seamless tile
